verdict:
NO ENTRY AT $6.14 - fair-to-rich, not cheap, with the damage arriving through a channel neither the thesis nor red originally named.

WHAT I RE-VERIFIED MYSELF, PER DOCTRINE. Blue overturned a red finding and introduced a new decisive number, so both got re-fetched. (1) The POS AM: my own EDGAR type-filtered browse returns POS AM 0001753926-26-000290 dated 2026-02-10 - it EXISTS, exactly as blue found. Red declared it a phantom off a 40-most-recent browse that didn't reach it: a browse-window artifact, the precise error class red prosecuted elsewhere in its own document. Blue's substance ruling also holds - it is the at-IPO post-effective amendment, not a resale shelf, so post-lockup supply remains Rule-144 dribble. (2) The NII line: my proxy-fetch of the statements exhibit (accession 004073, note 16) prints net interest income R$1,095,520k for 2Q26 vs R$1,084,763k for 2Q25 (+1.0%), 6M R$2,178,328k vs R$2,199,787k (-1.0%). Digit-for-digit what blue reported. On a loan book up 21.2%, flat NII is ~17% per-loan margin compression - present-tense damage from the secured-mix shift, not a November question.

THE CASE AS IT NOW STANDS. The screen fired on an IPO-vintage artifact (the 52-week high IS the IPO week; a 6-month-old busted IPO has no meaningful dd52), but the cause-check found a real earnings-quality event: 2Q pre-tax earnings fell 68.7% (EBT R$115.0M vs R$367.9M) while headline net income was held up by a ~R$85M tax credit. Blue's YoY bridge decomposes the EBT fall entirely into ECL front-load (+R$210.7M) plus SG&A/customer-acquisition (+R$139.2M) - the IFRS-9 growth-accounting story red told is CONFIRMED - but the NII-flat finding restores a structural margin leg the thesis had right for the wrong reason (mix, not the misbound FGTS rate cap; the capped-collateral FGTS line SHRANK 6.7% QoQ and the +48% grower is 3.8% of book). The tax line is unmodelable quarter-to-quarter (2Q reversed ~R$180M of 1Q current tax), so the 3Q pre-commitment 'sequentially higher income' must be graded on EBT, explicitly.

VALUATION: ~1.09x book on R$4,799.2M of equity that is +51% in six months from IPO proceeds. LTM ROE 21.6% is a dead-basis number earned mostly on pre-IPO equity; forward ROE on full equity at normalized tax is ~7-10%. At ~1.09x book that is fair-to-rich. Not orphan-RP_FAIR carry either - fairness is NOT verified while the tax line is unmodelable and the margin trajectory unresolved.

GATE DESIGN: blue's no-gate ruling is right and I adopt it. The post-lockup Rule-144 bleed (expiry 2026-08-10, no resale shelf) makes the 52-week low untrustworthy as support - a price gate would fill on supply, not information. Event/data gates only: the 3Q print graded on EBT and NII-vs-loan-growth, any resale registration, or CMN/CNPS text hardening the consignado cap.
blue_ruling: PARTIALLY OVERTURNED, and blue's work was the best in the batch. Blue sustained red's product-misbinding kill (the thesis's one 'STRUCTURAL' leg), sustained the tax venue-divergence and the ROE basis-corruption, OVERTURNED red's 'POS AM is a phantom' on a targeted EDGAR type-search, closed red's declared coverage gap by fetching the statements exhibit red missed (one accession over), and produced the case's center of gravity - NII flat on a book up 21% - which neither prior bench had. I re-fetched both decisive items per BLUE-CORRECTIONS-AUDITED and blue is verbatim right on both.
reopen_gates: DATA (primary, dated ~2026-11-11): the 3Q26 print graded on EBT AND NII-vs-loan-growth, never on net income. Management pre-committed 'sequentially higher income starting in the third quarter' - the falsifiable version is EBT > R$115.0M with NII growing at a rate meaningfully closer to loan growth. EBT up but NII still flat = the credit engine is growing margin-free; the bear hardens.
EVENT: any resale registration (F-1/F-3/424B) appearing on EDGAR - converts the Rule-144 dribble into a dated supply event and re-opens the entry question at whatever level it clears.

EVENT: CMN/CNPS regulatory text extending a HARD cap to INSS consignado or mandating FGTS pledge - would convert the struck rate-cap leg into a real structural break on the 73%-of-book core product. Red's mind-change trigger, kept.

DATA: note-level ECL disclosure showing the front-load ratio (day-1 ECL on new vintages vs stock) normalizing while originations continue - would separate growth-spend from deterioration and could re-rate forward ROE above the 7-10% band.
DATA (hygiene before any sizing): live FX and live spot - every valuation number in this record uses an estimated BRL 5.33 and a pack-sourced $6.14; IBKR was denied to all three benches.
